_description: Dashboard filter action: selecting marks on one sheet filters the other sheets on the dashboard (Tableau Cloud accepted this exact shape)

action._placement: Child of a top-level <actions> element, which sits directly after </datasources> and before <worksheets>

notes.placement: <actions> is a workbook-level element, not a dashboard child. Order: <datasources>, <actions>, <worksheets>, <dashboards>, <windows>.
notes.name_format: The action name is bracketed, e.g. [Action1_FilterArtist], and unique across the workbook.
notes.source_names: source/@dashboard must match a dashboard name and source/@worksheet a worksheet on that dashboard, exactly (the validator checks both).
notes.special_fields_all: special-fields=all filters on every field of the selected marks. To filter on specific fields only, omit it and add <param name='field-captions' value='Artist' />.
notes.target: target names the dashboard whose sheets get filtered; every sheet on it except the source is a target.
notes.auto_clear: auto-clear='true' shows all values again when the selection is cleared; omit it to keep the last filter.
notes.verify: Filter actions don't show up in a static PNG. Verify them by clicking a mark in the live view (see rendering.md).
